answer: Each epoch the protocol publishes a baseline answer to the same prompt and discounts every submission that sits close to it, because a farm driven by one template reproduces that baseline. Wording and angle that a raven would envy keep full reward, while the sweet nectar of copied output is taxed to zero. A farm of n clones must pay for n separately designed answers, and every extra plume of near-duplicates deepens the discount, so cost climbs with n while income falls.
